Project 01 / Robotics / Research

Surgical robotics

Independent researcherMay — Sep 2026
PythonPyBulletInverse kinematics

Built a 3D simulation of a da Vinci Research Kit patient-side manipulator to evaluate 81 candidate base poses across three surgical scenarios.

Ranked feasible configurations using inverse kinematics, collision and clearance checks, workspace coverage, manipulability, joint margin, and robustness metrics.

Generated CSV/JSON results and figures for a manuscript submitted to LEPIC at Hospital das Clínicas, University of São Paulo Medical School, under Dr. Ricardo Zugaib Abdalla.

Simulation research; no clinical performance claims. The workspace graphic on this page is an illustration, not a plot of experimental results.
